title: Stake or Die
subtitle: Pick your rider
intro: Choose a character to represent you. Use the thumbnails, arrows, or arrow keys to switch.
dialogIntro: Back {name}. Your deposit stays yours and keeps earning — only the yield is shared with your rider and the Gnars treasury.
disclaimer: Your deposit stays yours and is withdrawable anytime. Rates vary; this isn't financial advice.

vlad.name: Vlad
vlad.tagline: Ships at midnight, shreds at dawn.

will.name: Will
will.tagline: Rolls in quiet, leaves a mark.

orbit.title: Sponsorship flow
orbit.subtitle: The Gnars treasury at the center, athletes in the first orbit, backers in the second. Each stake’s value sits on its line; support flows inward.

dlg.withdrewDesc: Your principal is back in your wallet.
dlg.usdcOnlyDesc: The ETH vault isn’t live yet.
dlg.noVaultDesc: {name} doesn’t have a sponsorship vault yet.
dlg.stakedDesc: Your deposit stays yours — withdraw whenever you want.

opp.estNote: ≈{rate}% APR estimate — swings with the MOR price and pool size.
opp.mainnetWarn: Ethereum mainnet — real gas. Principal unlocks after a 7-day lock.
opp.donateOpt: Optionally donate your MOR to the split
opp.estYearNote: Paid in MOR on Arbitrum — a live estimate, not a guarantee.
opp.stakedMorDesc: Earning MOR on Arbitrum — your principal unlocks after 7 days.
opp.lineEmpty: Empty bag? Come on — drop something in and let's roll.
opp.lineBig: {amount} {asset}?! That's sponsor money. I'm dropping in.
opp.lineStable: Steady wins. {you} {asset} a year back to you — I'll take my cut in grip tape.
opp.lineVar: ~{rate}% APR is a big air. Could land clean, could slam. You in?

lock.title: Lock your MOR claim to earn more
lock.explain: Your stETH stays liquid — withdraw after the 7-day window, whenever you want. You only defer WHEN you can claim the MOR you earn; in exchange your reward multiplier goes up.
lock.oneway: A lock can only be extended later, never shortened.
lock.summaryNone: No lock — base rate, and you can claim your MOR whenever you like.
lock.summaryLocked: Locking {label} → {mult}× the MOR share, in exchange for not claiming it until then.
lock.stethNote: Either way your stETH principal is never locked by this — only the 7-day withdraw rule applies.

lootbox.title: Rewards ready
lootbox.bridging: MOR claimed — bridging to Arbitrum (~a few min). Come back to Split it.

admin.title: Sponsorship vaults
admin.desc: One Morpho vault per rider. Deposits earn on Moonwell; half the yield becomes a fee split Gnars 25% / athlete 25% (the depositor keeps 50%). Owner = SOPA Safe. You sign the deploy and the batch — 1 of the Safe’s 2 confirmations.
admin.pasteHint: Paste the addresses above into src/lib/gnars-vaults.ts (the rider’s vault/adapter/split) to light up the sponsorship on /stake.
admin.deployedToastDesc: Approve the batch in the SOPA Safe to activate.

positions.title: Your positions
positions.subtitle: Your Morpheus Capital stakes — deposit, MOR earned, and when each lock lifts.
positions.connect: Connect your wallet to see your positions.
positions.none: No Morpheus stake yet. Back a rider above to start earning MOR.
positions.claimHint: To claim, open the reward box (bottom-right) once the MOR unlock date has passed — it bridges your MOR to Arbitrum and splits it to your wallet.
positions.powerLockNote: A far-off MOR unlock means a longer power-lock was chosen at deposit (higher APR / power factor) — the MOR stays locked until that date.
